title: Adapter — unify interfaces (Javascript)
description: An adapter translates one interface into another so incompatible code can work together. The classic "make the old API look like the new one" move.
how_it_works: The adapter wraps the legacy call and reshapes its output to the new contract.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: Adapters accumulate — schedule the real migration instead of stacking them.
